Today is about speed, power, and repeatable high-intensity efforts.
Push the 200m Run at a fast but controlled pace, then immediately get on the Echo Bike and accumulate as many calories as possible with the remaining time.
The 90 seconds of rest should allow you to recover enough to attack the next interval. Don t blow up in the first few rounds. Find an aggressive pace you can repeat and challenge yourselt to maintain your calorie output across all 10 sets.
